title: CanaCapabilityContract v1 (minimal slice)
description: The minimal machine-readable capability contract (Workbench mandate, contract-shaped Track A scope). CANA owns this grammar; providers implement capabilities behind it. Deliberately small: fields are added by evidence of need, not invented ahead of use.

real_outcome.description: The real-world outcome this capability affects — not its implementation.

canonical_actions.description: One semantic action per behavior. Chat, palette, UI, automation and agent invocation must all resolve to these — one action, one home.

entry.description: The single semantic implementation (route, script, or module export).

continuation_hooks.description: Which continuation triggers this capability creates or consumes.
